purpose: Track provenance, access conditions, licenses, and task compatibility before data ingestion or model training.

datasets.title: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Positions Dataset
datasets.limitations: Non-commercial, share-alike terms. Position labels support descriptive transitions between sampled annotations, not guard-drop labels or continuous dwell-time estimates. Dataset coverage is limited to six sparring sequences and is not professional-match coverage.

analysis_approval.reviewer: User selected the ViCoS candidate for non-commercial position analysis in this session

image_training_approval.reviewer: User requested work with image data after selecting the ViCoS candidate
image_training_approval.scope: Exploratory image classification of the dataset's 18 annotated position classes only; not guard-drop prediction or general athlete evaluation.

training_approval.reviewer: User requested training on publicly accessible martial-arts datasets; scope limited to this licensed non-commercial ViCoS position task
training_approval.scope: Train an exploratory classifier for the dataset's 18 BJJ position labels using its precomputed pose1/pose2 coordinates. Not RGB-video training, guard-drop prediction, or general athlete evaluation.

datasets.title: NTU RGB+D 120 Skeleton Data
datasets.limitations: Registration, request, and release agreement required; academic non-commercial research only under the published terms. Not a guard-drop annotation set.

datasets.title: Human3.6M
datasets.limitations: Academic-use request conditions apply; daily-activity motion capture, not combat-performance labels.

datasets.title: Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones
datasets.limitations: Daily activities from smartphone inertial sensors; not video skeleton sequences or combat-technique labels.
